title: I cant make my sprites transparent

posts.author: cartoonfan
posts.body: when I import a sprite (In rpg maker xp) it skips the part where you set the transparency so all my sprites look weird

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
what format do your sprites use, and what program do you use to create them?
The best way should be to use png with native transparency (alpha-layer).
the color replacement transparency used with jpg has problems (higher RAM use) and should not be used if you can use true transparency.
what you describe usually happens if you use a format that has an alpha layer for transparency, but not used that alpha-transparency in the picture itself - the engine does not ask for a color replacement if the format is supposed to have its own transparency.
